title: Tiffany Haddish's charity gives 2,000+ suitcases yearly to foster youth, inspired by her childhood
summary_full: Drawing from her challenging childhood in the foster care system, Tiffany Haddish founded the She Ready Foundation to uplift vulnerable youth. The charity distributes thousands of suitcases yearly to children in need, collaborating with prominent brands such as Samsonite for high-grade products. Beyond luggage, the foundation focuses on career development and mentorship, with recent programs including a film project that allowed participants to learn production skills and express their creativity.
